job.title: Grounds Maintenance Officer | Darwin | NT
job.description:

  • Support energy infrastructure planning, mine expansions, generation developments and large industrial energy projects from early assessment through to execution.

  • Provide strategic advice to clients on energy supply options, project economics, infrastructure requirements and delivery considerations.

  • Ability to coordinate technical, commercial and project specialists, review their outputs and challenge assumptions without necessarily undertaking detailed engineering or modelling personally.
  • Experience providing owner-side advice or overseeing external contractors and delivery partners on capital or infrastructure projects.
